title: Appointed as Assistant
original: {@nickname}, compared to the old ones, today's battle are too relaxed and juvenile. They are weak. Weak enough to make weapons rust. And once a warrior's weapons rust, death soon follows.

title: Talk 1
original: Life is but a brief flicker before the vast maw of annihilation. Cherish that view of the sunset while you still can, {@nickname}.

title: Talk 2
original: Practical exercises? Nah, I'm not interested. While Rhodes Island boasts many powerful warriors, squandering one's physical strength on a game is wasteful. Only on the edge of life and death does the clashing of swords have value.

title: Talk 3
original: I'm not concerned with the plight of the Infected? Hmph, don't misunderstand me - fighting in vain is what I hate. No enemy worth spilling my blood has come forward, and that's all there is to it.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Rampant slaughter liberates your inner instinct, 'teamwork' only robs you of it. What 'trust' and 'strategizing' buy you are nothing but illusions of security. And these illusions, {@nickname}, will one day cost you your life.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: This blade ran through two crown princes, and this other one slew three generals. In our chaotic world, anything can happen. I don't know who will claim my life, but on that day, I sure hope it'll be more exciting than when I took these lives.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Shining, huh? A pity, she could have been a worthy adversary. But after she got pulled into that mess with the 'Confessarii,' I bet she felt her blade had been besmirched. Hmph, Swordsmen without faith in their swords are beneath mention.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: {@nickname}, you remember that battle, right? After killing all the ambushers, I led the survivors and charged straight into the traitor's fortress. I was the only one who made it out alive. How did it all start? Oh, you know the answer to that. I've seen you before, and my memory is very good.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: {@nickname}, help me fetch those seeds in the cupboard, won't you? Thank you. Yes, I'm actually quite fond of flowers. No matter how brilliantly they blossom, their petals must wither and fall into the wind. When will the petals wither next, Doctor?

title: Idle
original: Vigilance can keep you alive, {@nickname}.

title: Onboard
original: We meet again, {@nickname}. Don't worry, I understand the situation you're in now, and pose no threat to you. I shall be your blade, so use me as you see fit, Doctor.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: The skills a great warrior needs are those which defy recording.

title: Promotion 1
original: Promotion? What? So you actually care about these rituals now?

title: Promotion 2
original: I have no concept of what it's like to be Infected. Perhaps Rhodes Island can help me understand. I don't care, but if you have your own considerations. Fine, I'll hear them out.

title: Added to Squad
original: Ahh, I've longed for a hurricane of blood.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I've been a captain before, and it didn't end well.

title: Depart
original: I will bathe in their blood.

title: Begin Operation
original: Let's begin.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Do not interfere.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Mind your own business.

title: Deployment 1
original: So, who shall be my opponent?

title: Deployment 2
original: Will it be you? Or maybe you?

title: In Battle 1
original: The blade brings the flame.

title: In Battle 2
original: The bone falls with blood.

title: In Battle 3
original: Whose name will you cry as you pass?

title: In Battle 4
original: I don't give a damn.

title: 4-star Result
original: Did this battle satisfy you?

title: 3-star Result
original: A weak enemy proves nothing. Search for a worthier battlefield.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: A dedicated opponent will prove to be a worthy adversary in the future, let them do just that.

title: Operation Failure
original: The rest of you, go. It has always been my job to destroy the pursuing enemy.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: It's pretty quiet here.

title: Tap
original: Yeah?

title: Trust Tap
original: You're just in time, I find myself in need of a whetstone…

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Time never ceases to pass. If you make no progress at this stage in your journey, then as a wizened tree does, your hours will rot away, and lose any ability to meet the coming spring. Happy New Year, {@nickname}, and don't forget your own goals.

title: Greeting
original: Not bad, you're still alive.

title: Birthday
original: Here is a flower I grew. Take it. You don't need to assign it too much meaning. All I hope is that before you greet life's withering, you come upon a time in which you blossom at full might. Happy birthday.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I think of what reasons brought me to Rhodes Island, Doctor, and there is only you. I allow you to use me as your blade, but in kind, you provide me amusing prey and durable whetstones. But don't disappoint me. For if you do, I cannot guarantee that someday this blade will not point at you.
